Acme Data is the analytics platform for retailers.
About the role
You will join a small team that owns the company's data platform end to end.
What you'll do:
Design and build batch and streaming pipelines with Airflow and Kafka.
Model the warehouse in dbt and keep data quality high.
Requirements:
3+ years of experience as a Data Engineer.
Strong SQL and Python. Experience with Snowflake or BigQuery.
Nice to have:
ClickHouse, Spark, Terraform.
Perks & Benefits
Hybrid work, gym membership, free lunch every day and a yearly team retreat.
We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company.
